title: UI polish T4: appearance setting System/Light/Dark
description: Segmented row in Settings, folio.workspace.appearance key, data-theme on html, Cmd+Shift+L, no flash; owner answer 2: ALSO add core:window:allow-set-theme and call setTheme so the Mac title bar follows (plan T4). Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-ui-polish/PLAN.md exactly (its section for this task: Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, plus the five answered Open questions). Protocol: serial check slot via files add before expensive checks, pinned Node, quoted --outDir, no installs, no commits, status CLAIMED, independent review required.

review.note: APPROVED (status stays CLAIMED; owner real use not done). Evidence in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui-t4-review/. CODE: key exactly folio.workspace.appearance, stored {theme,palette}, parse per-field fallback; main.tsx applies data-theme before createRoot; dark block under @media dark :root:not([data-theme=light]) + :root[data-theme=dark] (color-scheme dark) + :root[data-theme=light]{color-scheme:light}; Segmented = role=group + aria-pressed buttons as the PLAN interface specifies (reviewer brief asked radiogroup/aria-checked: plan governs, noted), square, tokens only, arrows wrap, focus ring via global T2 recipe; Settings row has no caption; setTheme lazy-imported, only when desktop, System->null, errors swallowed; capability line exactly core:window:allow-set-theme; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L: no collision (App binds s,\\,k,Shift+n,Shift+s; Writer Shift+f,Shift+x; no native menu in lib.rs). FAIL-FIRST: read all 3 logs (unit: module missing; browser: 5 new fail/2 old pass on pre-T075 build; parity: --muted doctored fails). Reproduced parity fail on scratch copy ui-t4-review/parity (--line doctored in data-theme=dark block -> 1 failed; undoctored 5/5). RERUN pinned Node 22.23.3: tsc exit 0; vitest appearance+designTokens 10/10; Playwright appearance+notice+sidebar-selection+features+layout+accessibility on ui-t4/dist port 1567, 1 worker, 0 retries: 33/33 (ui-t4-review/browser.log); dist newer than every src/tests file. FIRST PAINT (ui-t4-review/firstpaint.json, Chromium): stored dark under light OS -> data-theme set at 25ms while #root had 0 children, html bg rgb(32,32,35), first-paint 32ms; light under dark OS -> all 14 colour tokens equal the light values, color-scheme light; garbage/partial/missing tolerated, no page errors. NATIVE: slot unowned; smoke rebuild EXIT 0 (capability accepted), Cargo.lock shasum unchanged; native-screens 8 PNGs exit 0 (OS is Dark). Hashes light/dark: projects cb77024/dddf0da, writing b0f1047/9eee8bd, research f5558aa/342fad2, settings 72b825d/90065d8 -- all 4 pairs differ (pre-T075 ui-t0/native-final: all 4 pairs byte-identical, dataTheme null). Reports: light dataTheme=light prefersDark=false; dark dataTheme=dark prefersDark=true. Viewed all 8: light set light (incl. native selects), dark set dark; Settings shows System/Light/Dark square row, selected blue semibold, no caption. dataTheme surviving the script reload = WKWebView localStorage round-trips the key. prefersDark=false under a Dark OS = WKWebView appearance changed, i.e. setTheme(light) ran natively with the capability granted (indirect). FINDING (non-blocking, follow-up suggested): parity test covers only the two dark blocks the plan names; on a scratch copy deleting :root[data-theme=light] still passes 5/5 (then Light under dark OS keeps color-scheme 'light dark' -> dark native controls/scrollbars); suggest asserting the light block exists with color-scheme light and that light and dark colour-token name sets match. Minor: spec (e) checks .settings-help only inside the row (verified visually instead). UNPROVEN: actual title-bar colour (snapshot shows only the WebView), Cmd+Shift+L inside WKWebView (native-screens does not press it), no-flash in WKWebView (first-paint measured in Chromium only), live System follow in the native app.
